LUV.thesis_one_line: Big US low-fare airline earning more per seat after adding bag fees and assigned seats, but fuel costs and a back-loaded 2026 forecast limit confidence.
kill_criteria: Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guide lowered below the $3.25 low end, or withdrawn.
Q3 2026 adjusted EPS below $0.50 (low end of guide).
Adjusted RASM growth below +10% YoY in Q4 2026 (Q2 2026: +20.1%; Q3 guide +17.5% to +19.5%).
Company gross leverage above 3.0x (2.1x at Q2) or liquidity below $4.0B ($5.3B at Q2).
2026 net capital spending above $3.5B, or H2 2026 operating cash flow less gross capex below -$0.5B.
key_adverse_facts: Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guide cut to $3.25-4.25 from at least $4.00 (22 Jul 2026); implies about $1.23-2.05 in Q4 versus $0.58 in Q4 2025.
Trailing operating cash flow less gross capex is -$457M; about $2.1B of debt due in 2027; current maturities jumped to $2,156M.
$285M reversal of breakage revenue recognised in 2022-2025 (special item); activist advisory costs; securities class actions over the December 2022 meltdown.
data_conflicts: Triage FCF yield -4.0% vs about -2.2% from filings (gross capex, before $450M H1 2026 asset-sale proceeds).
Triage cited general knowledge for the activist; no 13D opened here, stake not stated.
